title: Add autosave drafts, My Drafts section, and unpublish dialog

requirements.text: Add a 'draft' status to the backend post data model so posts can be saved as drafts (not publicly visible). Drafts must be stored persistently per user and retrievable via a dedicated query that returns only the caller's own drafts.

quotes: Vi ha en funktion som gör att ej färdiga inlägg kan sparas som utkast

acceptanceCriteria: A post can have status 'draft' in addition to existing statuses
Draft posts are not returned by the public getAllPublishedPosts query
A new query getDraftsByUser returns only the authenticated caller's own drafts
A draft can be created, updated, and promoted to published status

requirements.text: Add backend support for saving and updating a post as a draft, including a saveDraft mutation that accepts the same fields as createPost and returns the draft post ID, and an updateDraft mutation for updating existing drafts.

quotes: Automatisk sparning av inlägg som håller på att skrivas (autosave till utkast)
Manuell "Spara som utkast"-funktion för ofärdiga inlägg

acceptanceCriteria: saveDraft creates a new post with draft status and returns its ID
updateDraft updates an existing draft post's fields
Only the post owner can update or delete their own drafts
A draft can be deleted permanently via a deleteDraft or reusing the existing deletePost mutation

requirements.text: In the Create Post page (CreatePostPage.tsx), implement autosave every 30 seconds while the user is actively editing. When any field (title, author, content, category) has non-empty content, the form should automatically save/update a draft in the backend. Show a subtle 'Draft saved' indicator near the form after each successful autosave.

quotes: Autosave var 30 sekunder – inlägg som håller på att skrivas sparas automatiskt som utkast

acceptanceCriteria: Autosave triggers every 30 seconds if any form field has been modified
Autosave calls saveDraft on first save and updateDraft on subsequent saves for the same session
A small non-intrusive 'Draft saved' message appears briefly after each successful autosave
Autosave does not trigger if all fields are empty
Autosave timer is cleared when the user submits or cancels the form

requirements.text: Add a 'Save as Draft' button to the Create Post page form (CreatePostPage.tsx), positioned near the existing 'Skapa inlägg' submit button. Clicking it immediately saves the current form state as a draft in the backend and navigates the user to the 'My Drafts' section.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Save as Draft' button is visible in the Create Post form
Clicking it saves the current form data as a draft and redirects to My Drafts
The button shows a loading state while the save is in progress
A toast notification confirms successful draft save

requirements.text: Create a separate 'My Drafts' page or clearly delineated section accessible from the main navigation (for authenticated users). It should list all of the current user's draft posts, showing title, last saved timestamp, and a brief content preview. Each draft card must have three actions: 'Edit' (loads draft into the edit form), 'Publish' (publishes it immediately), and 'Delete' (removes the draft with a confirmation prompt).

quotes: Separat "Mina utkast"-sektion där användaren kan se, redigera och publicera sina sparade utkast

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can navigate to 'My Drafts' from the header navigation
The page lists all drafts belonging to the current user
Each draft shows title, last saved date, and a truncated content preview
Edit action loads the draft into the Edit Post page with all fields pre-populated
Publish action promotes the draft to published status and removes it from the drafts list
Delete action shows a confirmation dialog before permanently removing the draft
An empty state message is shown when there are no drafts
The drafts list is not visible to unauthenticated users

requirements.text: When a user disables the 'Publicera omedelbart' (Publish immediately) toggle on an already-published post (visible in CreatePostPage and EditPostPage), show a confirmation dialog with three options: 'Delete permanently' (deletes the post entirely), 'Save as Draft' (converts the post to draft status), and 'Cancel' (dismisses the dialog and keeps the toggle enabled/post published). The toggle should not change state until the user makes a selection.

quotes: Alla tre valen ska vara tillgängliga
Dialogruta med tre val när "Publicera omedelbart"-toggeln stängs av på ett publicerat inlägg: Radera helt / Spara som utkast / Avbryt

acceptanceCriteria: Turning off the 'Publicera omedelbart' toggle on an existing published post immediately shows a dialog
The dialog presents three clearly labeled buttons: 'Delete permanently', 'Save as Draft', and 'Cancel'
'Delete permanently' deletes the post and redirects the user away from the edit page
'Save as Draft' converts the post status to draft and optionally redirects to My Drafts
'Cancel' dismisses the dialog and restores the toggle to its enabled (published) state
The toggle does not visually change to off until the user confirms 'Save as Draft' or 'Delete permanently'

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks in useQueries.ts for the new draft-related backend calls: saveDraft, updateDraft, getDraftsByUser, and deleteDraft (or reuse deletePost). Ensure query cache for drafts is properly invalidated after any mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: useSaveDraft mutation hook is available and calls the backend saveDraft method
useUpdateDraft mutation hook is available
useGetMyDrafts query hook fetches the current user's drafts
useDeleteDraft mutation hook is available
All draft mutations invalidate the getDraftsByUser query cache on success

constraints: Draft posts must never appear in the public getAllPublishedPosts feed
Only the post owner can read, edit, or delete their own drafts
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Autosave on the Edit Post page (only Create Post page for now)
Sharing or collaboration on drafts between users
Admin visibility into other users' drafts
